description: PAID ($0.02). One series (e.g. vat, policy-rate, minimum-wage, corporate-tax) across up to 10 countries of this brand in one call; each row carries its own source, dates and labels, and countries without the series are listed under missing. Malformed requests are refused free. Pass api_key if you have one; otherwise the response explains how to pay via x402. After a 200, bind get_changes (free poll) or register_alert (HMAC push; Register: $0 · Delivery after trial: $0.05) on this series so a later gazette does not silently retire the value.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes on this brand, at most 10

series.description: Series id from list_series, e.g. vat

name: compare_series

outputSchema.description: One series across up to 10 countries, each row cited

error.description: Present on a free refusal or error; no charge

payment_required.description: true when the call needs payment; how_to_pay explains x402 or card

confidence_label.description: Evidence verdict derived from source type, verification age and the stale flag (answers: the weakest series read). Rules at /label-rules

coverage_label.description: How much of the question is covered: ready = complete; partial = held with a disclosed limitation or default; gap = no number served. Rules at /label-rules

label_basis.description: Inputs and the rule ids that produced the two labels
